description: This file defines a utility class PeriodWorker with methods to create database query conditions based on time periods, specifically generating EntityCondition objects for filtering data within a given date range.

classes.name: PeriodWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for creating EntityCondition filters based on time periods.

methods.name: getFilterByPeriodExpr
methods.description: Returns an EntityCondition that filters records where the specified field falls within the given time period encapsulated in a GenericValue object.
